newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains down on sterling bounce-back.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains down on sterling bounce-back.

text.p: LIFFE grains futures prices came off as sterling bounced back against the mark, traders said.
But there was good support at 1.50 stg down on active May wheat, one trader said. That was May's low at 96.50 stg, but it recovered to end at 96.70 stg.
Volume on May was 294 lots, out of a total 471 lots traded on wheat.
There was some profit taking in reaction to Wednesday's sharp rise, which sent May up 2.50 stg. "Maybe 2.50 was a bit overdone," the trader said.
Barley also fell, with November, the most active contract, down 0.90 stg at 95.00 stg. November volume was 37 lots of a total of 51 lots.
